species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 54°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–30 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
West wind at 17 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.

species.name: Crappie
